title: Wearable startup CUDIS launches a new health ring line with an AI-fueled ‘coach’
description: The wearable incentivizes healthy behavior with points that can be redeemed for health products.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: The public opposition to AI infrastructure is heating up
description: Public backlash over the data center boom is leading to a variety of draconian policies — including bans on new construction.
author: Lucas Ropek

title: Gemini can now automate some multi-step tasks on Android
description: Gemini on Android will be able to automate tasks involving rideshare requests, or grocery or food delivery, says Google.
author: Sarah Perez

title: OpenAI COO says ads will be ‘an iterative process’
description: COO Brad Lightcap noted that ads can add to the product experience of users if they are done right. He urged to give OpenAI a few months to see how the company fares in rolling out the product.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: OpenClaw creator’s advice to AI builders is to be more playful and allow yourself time to improve
description: Peter Steinberger talks about the creation of his viral AI agent OpenClaw and how being more "playful" makes for a better way to learn AI coding.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Have hard-won scaling lessons to share? Take the stage at TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026
description: Apply to speak at TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 by April 17 for a chance to lead a roundtable or breakout session for 1,000 founders and investors. If you’ve built, backed, or operated inside high-growth startups, your experience could shape how the next wave of founders scales.
author: TechCrunch Events

title: About 12% of US teens turn to AI for emotional support or advice
description: General-purpose tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok are not designed for this use, making mental health professionals wary.
author: Amanda Silberling

title: 3 days left: Save up to $680 on your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 ticket
description: Just 3 days left to save up to $680 on your TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 ticket. Offer ends on Friday, February 27 at 11:59 p.m. PT. Don't miss unparalleled, curated networking and valuable insights from 250+ tech leaders, and discover 300+ breakout innovations. Register now.
author: TechCrunch Events

title: US tells diplomats to lobby against foreign data sovereignty laws
description: The Trump administration has ordered U.S. diplomats to lobby against countries' attempts to regulate how American tech companies handle foreigners' data.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Amazon’s AI-powered Alexa+ gets new personality options
description: Users will be able to choose from Alexa styles like Brief, Chill or Sweet, Amazon says.
author: Sarah Perez

title: Adobe Firefly’s video editor can now automatically create a first draft from footage
description: Adobe Firefly is getting a new feature called Quick Cut that uses AI to edit footage to create a first draft of the final video based on user instructions.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Jira’s latest update allows AI agents and humans to work side by side
description: Atlassian is unveiling "agents in Jira" which gives users the ability to assign and manage work given to AI agents the same as humans.
author: Rebecca Szkutak

title: Khosla’s Keith Rabois backs Comp, which wants to bolster HR teams with AI
description: The HR tech startup, which currently operates in Brazil, has raised a $17.25 million Series A.
author: Marina Temkin

title: India’s AI boom pushes firms to trade near-term revenue for users
description: ChatGPT and rivals are testing whether India's massive AI user boom can translate into paying customers as free offers wind down.
author: Jagmeet Singh

title: Nvidia challenger AI chip startup MatX raised $500M
description: The startup was founded by former Google TPU engineers in 2023.
author: Marina Temkin

title: Spanish ‘soonicorn’ Multiverse Computing releases free compressed AI model
description: Spanish startup Multiverse Computing has released a new version of its HyperNova 60B model on Hugging Face that, it says, bests Mistral's model.
author: Anna Heim

title: Uber engineers built an AI version of their boss
description: Uber CEO Dara Khosrowshahi said the company’s employees have gone all in on AI, going so far as to build a chatbot of him that they use to practice their pitches.
author: Kirsten Korosec

title: Anthropic won’t budge as Pentagon escalates AI dispute
description: The Pentagon has given Anthropic until Friday to loosen AI guardrails or face potential penalties, escalating a high-stakes dispute that raises questions about government leverage, vendor dependence, and investor confidence in defense tech.
author: Rebecca Bellan

title: Google adds a way to create automated workflows to Opal
description: Google is adding a new feature to Opal to create automated workflows
author: Ivan Mehta

title: OpenAI COO says ‘we have not yet really seen AI penetrate enterprise business processes’
description: There is a lot of talk around AI agents taking over business processes and claiming that "SaaS is dead." While these predictions have moved SaaS stocks at times, they haven't really come true.
author: Ivan Mehta

title: Music generator ProducerAI joins Google Labs
description: Wyclef Jean used Google's AI music tools on his new song "Back in Abu Dhabi."
author: Amanda Silberling

title: Meta strikes up to $100B AMD chip deal as it chases ‘personal superintelligence’
description: Meta is buying billions of dollars in AMD AI chips in a multiyear deal tied to a 160 million-share warrant, deepening its push to diversify beyond Nvidia and expand data center capacity.
author: Rebecca Bellan
